### Justice for Ish-Bosheth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/justice-for-ish-bosheth
Passage: 2 Samuel 4:10-11
Points:
- A godly ruler submits to God's law rather than seizing power through violent shortcuts.
- Baanah and Rechab murdered the defenseless Ish-bosheth in his home, expecting David to reward their betrayal.
- David upheld biblical justice by holding the assassins accountable and executing them for murder.
- The conspirators falsely claimed God's sanction to validate actions the Lord never commanded.
- Believers must never use the pretext of serving Christ to justify wicked deeds.
